name: still-planned-snapshot-db-side
body: Limit: this test's still-planned snapshot asserts the DB row plus all incident/outgoing edges, not the exported graph.jsonl record — the export models edges as flat records but offers no queryable relation view, so row-and-edge equality is asserted against db.lbug. Upgrade if a future task requires export-vs-DB parity for still-planned rows.
